category_justification: It is a venture-funded for-profit infrastructure company, listed as 'Private sector' in the RFI respondent index.

name: IASA
resolved_name: Iasa (Iasa Global), the professional body for technology architects - submission from its AI Architectures Community
description: Iasa, originally the International Association of Software Architects and now branded Iasa Global, is a nonprofit professional membership association for business technology and IT architects. It maintains an architecture body of knowledge, publishes competency standards, and offers certification and training credentials such as CITA to individual practitioner members worldwide. Its RFI response was filed by the organization's AI Architectures Community, a member special-interest group.
justification: Its primary activity is operating a membership association that advances the professional interests, standards, and credentials of individual technology architects.

alternates.justification: A large part of its operations is delivering architecture training courses and certification preparation.
Its curriculum is specifically computer and software architecture instruction.
It also serves corporate members seeking to build internal architecture practices.

category_justification: It is a dues-based professional association of individual architect members, and the RFI index classifies it as an 'Industry/professional/scientific association.'

name: ICF Incorporated
resolved_name: ICF Incorporated, L.L.C., operating subsidiary of ICF International, Inc.
description: ICF Incorporated, L.L.C. is the principal operating subsidiary of ICF International, Inc., a publicly traded (Nasdaq: ICFI) consulting and technology services firm headquartered in Reston, Virginia. It delivers policy analysis, program implementation, digital modernization, and data and analytics services, with US federal, state, and local government agencies as its largest client base alongside energy utilities and commercial clients. The SEC classifies ICF International under SIC 8742, Management Consulting Services.
naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
justification: Its primary activity is providing management, program, and policy consulting services to government and commercial clients, matching the SEC's management-consulting designation.

alternates.justification: Much of its work is specialized program and regulatory consulting rather than general management advice.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Its energy, environment, and public-health practices provide scientific and technical advisory work.
A significant and growing share of revenue comes from IT modernization and systems integration for federal agencies.

category_justification: It is a publicly traded for-profit professional-services firm commenting in its own corporate capacity, not on behalf of named clients; listed as 'Private sector' in the RFI respondent index.

name: IMO Health
description: IMO Health, formerly Intelligent Medical Objects, is a privately held health information technology company headquartered in Rosemont, Illinois. It develops and licenses clinical terminology, medical vocabulary, and code-set products that map clinician-entered language to standards such as SNOMED CT, ICD-10, and LOINC inside electronic health record systems. Its customers include EHR vendors, health systems, payers, and life sciences firms that use its terminology assets for documentation, coding, and data-quality workflows.
justification: Its primary activity is licensing proprietary clinical terminology software products and platforms to healthcare organizations and EHR vendors.

alternates.naics_title: Web Search Portals and All Other Information Services
alternates.justification: Its core asset is a curated medical vocabulary database licensed as an information product rather than an application.
It performs customer-specific integration and mapping work within EHR implementations.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Its newer offerings are delivered as cloud-hosted data services and APIs.

category_justification: It is a private-equity-backed for-profit health IT vendor, listed as 'Private sector' in the RFI respondent index.

name: INCOMPAS
description: INCOMPAS is a Washington, D.C.-based trade association representing competitive broadband, internet, and communications companies, including network operators, streaming providers, and technology firms. It advocates before the Federal Communications Commission, Congress, and the courts on issues such as broadband deployment funding, spectrum policy, pole attachments, and competitive access to networks. The association also hosts policy summits and industry conferences for its member companies.
justification: Its primary activity is a dues-based membership association promoting the collective business and regulatory interests of competitive communications and internet companies, which is the defining activity of Business Associations.
category_justification: INCOMPAS is organized around a corporate membership base of competitive network and internet companies whose collective policy interests it represents before regulators and Congress.

name: IPC
description: IPC, which rebranded as the Global Electronics Association in 2025, is a member-based trade association serving the electronics manufacturing industry worldwide. It develops and publishes the widely used IPC standards for printed circuit board design, assembly, and acceptability, and provides certification, training, and workforce programs to member companies. It also conducts industry market research and advocates on supply-chain and manufacturing policy in the United States and abroad.
justification: IPC's primary activity is operating as a membership trade association that promotes the collective interests of electronics manufacturers, with standards development, training, and advocacy delivered as member services.

alternates.justification: Its standards-writing and individual certification programs resemble the technical credentialing work of a professional organization, though its membership is corporate rather than individual.
IPC operates a large training and certification business for electronics assembly workers, which is an educational support activity.

alternates.naics_title: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)
alternates.justification: A residual membership-organization code if its standards-setting role were treated as distinct from ordinary trade-association activity.

category_justification: IPC is a dues-paying corporate membership body for electronics manufacturers whose standards, training, and advocacy exist to serve those members' collective interests.

name: Imbue
description: Imbue is a San Francisco-based private artificial intelligence research company, previously named Generally Intelligent, that develops large models and autonomous coding agents capable of reasoning. The company raised over $200 million in 2023 from investors including Nvidia and Astera Institute to train its own foundation models and build agent tooling. Its work centers on AI research and on prototype software products that let users create and verify their own code.
naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
justification: Imbue's primary activity is original research and experimental development on AI reasoning models and agents rather than volume publication of a packaged commercial product.

alternates.justification: Imbue builds and distributes AI agent and coding software, which would be software publishing if product distribution rather than research were its main line.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Delivery of AI model inference as a hosted service falls under computing infrastructure and data processing services.
Would apply if the company principally wrote software to customer specification, which is not its stated model.

category_justification: Imbue is a venture-backed for-profit corporation with named institutional investors and commercial funding rounds.

name: Independent Community Bankers of America (ICBA)
description: The Independent Community Bankers of America is a national trade association representing community banks across the United States. It lobbies Congress and federal banking regulators on issues such as regulatory burden, deposit insurance, payments, and credit union competition, and operates affiliated education, payments, and services subsidiaries for members. ICBA also runs a political action committee and an annual national convention for its member banks.
justification: ICBA's primary activity is a membership trade association advancing the shared regulatory and business interests of community banks, which is squarely Business Associations.
category_justification: Its membership consists of community bank institutions whose collective interests it represents through lobbying, a PAC, and member services.

name: Innovate Boise
description: Innovate Boise presents itself online as a network accelerator in Boise, Idaho, that connects innovators, inventors, founders, industry participants, and mentors. Its publicly visible activity consists of running an innovation hackathon program and startup pitch resources that culminate in presentations at a regional conference innovation showcase. Public sources do not disclose its legal form, ownership, tax status, or whether it operates as a for-profit venture, a nonprofit, or a program of a larger civic or economic-development body.
justification: The only confirmable activity is organizing hackathons, mentor matching, and pitch events, a residual support-service activity, but the entity's legal form and primary line of business could not be verified.

alternates.justification: If it is a civic membership network of local founders and mentors, this code for community-oriented membership organizations would apply.
Its visible output is organizing hackathon and innovation-showcase events, which is event and show organizing.

alternates.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
alternates.justification: If it primarily advises and mentors startup founders on business formation and strategy, general management consulting would fit.

category_justification: Web research located only a marketing site and social profiles describing hackathon programming, with no registration, tax-status, or governance evidence to establish what kind of entity it is.

name: Integral AI
description: Integral AI is a venture-backed artificial intelligence startup, founded by a former Google AI researcher and headquartered in Tokyo, that develops foundation world models for robotics. The company builds vision-language-action systems intended to let robots learn and generalize across physical tasks, and raised seed funding of about $4.7 million before later model announcements. Its output is research-stage AI models rather than a shipped mass-market product line.
naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
justification: The company's primary activity is experimental research and development on robotics foundation models and world models rather than manufacturing or packaged software distribution.

alternates.justification: Its models are software that may be licensed and distributed to robotics developers, which would make it a software publisher.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Serving AI models to robotics customers via hosted inference is a data processing and computing infrastructure service.
Would apply if the firm mainly designed integrated robotic control systems for clients rather than doing its own R&D.

category_justification: Integral AI is a for-profit venture-funded startup with disclosed seed financing and commercial product announcements.

name: Intel
description: Intel Corporation is a publicly traded American semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It designs and manufactures microprocessors, chipsets, AI accelerators, and related silicon for personal computers, data centers, and edge devices, and operates its own wafer fabrication plants and a foundry services business. Intel is one of the largest semiconductor manufacturers in the world by revenue.
justification: Intel's primary activity is designing and fabricating semiconductor devices such as microprocessors and accelerators, the defining activity of this code.
category_justification: Intel is a publicly traded for-profit corporation listed on Nasdaq that sells semiconductor products commercially.

name: International Committee for Information Technology Standards (INCITS)
resolved_name: InterNational Committee for Information Technology Standards (INCITS), a standards body of the Information Technology Industry Council (ITI)
description: INCITS is the ANSI-accredited standards development organization for information and communications technology in the United States, operating under the Information Technology Industry Council. Its member companies, agencies, and organizations staff technical committees that write standards in areas such as storage interfaces, programming languages, biometrics, data management, and artificial intelligence. INCITS also serves as the US Technical Advisory Group administrator for corresponding ISO and IEC international standards committees.
justification: INCITS is a dues-based membership body whose technical committees are staffed by member organizations to advance the collective standards interests of the IT industry, matching the business association activity.

alternates.justification: Its committee work is performed by technical professionals writing standards, which resembles a professional organization's activity.

alternates.naics_title: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)
alternates.justification: A residual membership-organization code if standards development is treated as neither trade nor professional association activity.

alternates.naics_title: All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
alternates.justification: Would apply if INCITS were viewed as a fee-for-service technical standards administrator rather than a membership body.

category_justification: INCITS is a membership standards body whose voting members are companies and organizations, and it operates as a division of the trade association ITI.

name: Internet Works
description: Internet Works is a Washington, DC-based coalition of mid-sized internet and online-platform companies, launched in December 2020 by members including Etsy, eBay, Pinterest, Reddit, Snap, Tripadvisor, Vimeo, Automattic, Cloudflare and Dropbox. It advocates on federal technology policy, most prominently defending and shaping reform of Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act on behalf of companies that are not 'Big Tech'. It filed a response to the NITRD AI Action Plan RFI (90 FR 9088), where the official index labels it an industry/professional/scientific association.
justification: Its primary activity is representing the collective public-policy interests of a dues-paying membership of internet businesses, which is the defining activity of a business association.
category_justification: Its own launch materials and the NITRD respondent index describe it as a coalition of named member companies formed to advance their shared policy positions.

name: Intuit
description: Intuit Inc. is a publicly traded American financial technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California. It develops and publishes consumer and small-business financial software, including TurboTax, QuickBooks, Credit Karma and Mailchimp, sold largely as cloud subscriptions. It submitted a private-sector response to the NITRD AI Action Plan RFI (90 FR 9088).
justification: Intuit's primary activity is designing, publishing and licensing packaged and cloud-delivered financial and accounting software to consumers and businesses.
category_justification: It is a for-profit, publicly listed corporation (NASDAQ: INTU) commenting in its own commercial capacity, and the RFI index lists it as private sector.

name: Irepa International
description: Irepa International, LLC is a small privately held company based in Palm Desert/Palm Springs, California, led by CEO and co-founder Sanjiv S. Gupta. It markets itself as an Internet-of-Things consultant and solutions provider, with a stated focus on hydrogen generation and industrial automation delivered through a network of global technology partners. Its RFI submission advocated unbiased factual training data, sustainable and self-regulating AI data centers, and autonomous robotics oriented to human well-being.
justification: The firm's self-described core offering is consulting on and integrating IoT systems for industrial customers, which is systems planning and integration rather than product manufacturing.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Its hydrogen-generation and industrial-automation advisory work is technical consulting outside the computer-systems field.
Designing hydrogen generation and factory automation installations is engineering-services work.
Residual computer-services code if the IoT solution delivery is neither pure design nor programming.

category_justification: State and business-directory records list it as a for-profit LLC, and the NITRD index classifies it as private sector.

name: JA Analytics & Insights
description: JA Analytics & Insights, LLC is a small US consulting firm associated with statistician Alan Karr that designs, conducts and interprets quantitative and qualitative analyses for client organizations. Its stated competencies span statistics, data science and machine learning, human-centered artificial intelligence, behavioral science, human factors and data visualization. It filed a private-sector response to the NITRD AI Action Plan RFI (90 FR 9088).
naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
justification: Its primary activity is fee-based expert advice grounded in statistics and data science, which falls under scientific and technical consulting rather than software or management consulting.

alternates.justification: The firm frames its work as supporting clients' evidence-based strategic decisions, a management-consulting framing.
Applicable if its machine-learning and AI engagements are delivered mainly as custom-built analytic code.

alternates.naics_title: Marketing Research and Public Opinion Polling
alternates.justification: Its survey and qualitative research capability overlaps with contract research and polling services.

category_justification: It is a for-profit LLC with a registered trademark and a commercial services website, listed as private sector in the RFI index; it advises unnamed clients rather than a stated membership.

name: JP Morgan Chase
description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is the largest US bank holding company by assets, headquartered in New York City. Through Chase and its corporate and investment bank it provides consumer and commercial banking, credit cards, payments processing, investment banking, markets trading and asset and wealth management worldwide. It submitted a private-sector response to the NITRD AI Action Plan RFI (90 FR 9088).
justification: Its largest single line of business is deposit-taking and lending through Chase Bank, N.A., the classic commercial banking activity, even though the group is diversified.

alternates.justification: The named legal entity JPMorgan Chase & Co. is itself a bank holding company that owns and manages its banking subsidiaries.
Its corporate and investment bank is one of the world's largest securities underwriting and dealing operations.
Chase is among the largest US credit card issuers, a substantial standalone revenue line.

category_justification: It is a for-profit publicly traded corporation (NYSE: JPM) commenting on its own behalf, listed as private sector in the RFI index.

name: Jeopardizing Justice
description: Jeopardizing Justice is a small US group, based in Kamas, Utah, that describes itself as a coalition of legal and technology professionals concerned with the accuracy of legal transcripts. It raises awareness of the risks of using artificial intelligence and automatic speech recognition for court reporting through speakers, focus groups, podcasts, videos and studies, and works to develop best practices for transcript accuracy. It filed a response to the NITRD AI Action Plan RFI (90 FR 9088), where the official index labels it a non-profit.
justification: Its primary activity is convening legal and court-reporting professionals to set practice standards and advance their shared position on AI transcription, the defining work of a professional organization.

alternates.justification: Much of its output is public advocacy about AI risks in the justice system rather than member services.

alternates.naics_title: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)
alternates.justification: Residual membership-organization code if the group is too informal to qualify as a professional association.
Applicable if its participants are court-reporting firms advancing a shared commercial interest rather than individual professionals.

category_justification: Its own mission statement calls it 'a coalition of legal and technology professionals', a membership base, so the membership rule overrides the index's generic 'Non-profit' label.

name: Jobs for the Future
description: Jobs for the Future (JFF) is a national US nonprofit founded in 1983 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It works to transform the US education and workforce systems so that more workers, particularly those facing barriers, can reach quality jobs, doing so through research, program design and piloting, employer and policy initiatives, and its JFFLabs and impact-employer arms. It filed a non-profit response to the NITRD AI Action Plan RFI (90 FR 9088) on AI's effects on work and skills.
justification: Its primary activity is promoting systemic change in education and labor-market policy and practice on behalf of workers, which is social and economic advocacy rather than direct instruction.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: A large share of its output is applied social and labor-market research and evaluation.
It provides technical assistance, program design and consulting to colleges, schools and workforce boards.
It designs and supports upskilling and career-advancement training programs for adult workers.

category_justification: It is a 501(c)(3) charitable corporation (EIN 06-1164568, GuideStar) delivering a public-interest mission without a dues-paying membership base.

name: KEEL
description: KEEL refers to Knowledge Enhanced Electronic Logic, the proprietary AI technology of Compsim LLC, a small privately held firm in Brookfield, Wisconsin. Compsim develops and licenses KEEL toolkits and engines that let subject-matter experts encode explainable, auditable human-like judgment and decision logic for uses such as autonomous systems, command and control, and adaptive analytics. Its RFI submission argued that federal AI procurement should be capability-based rather than mandating specific machine-learning approaches.
justification: Compsim's primary activity is developing and licensing its own packaged KEEL software toolkits and runtime engines to customers rather than performing client-specific programming.

alternates.justification: Much of its revenue comes from applying KEEL to build bespoke decision-logic applications for defense and industrial clients.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: The firm operates substantially as an R&D shop advancing a novel non-machine-learning AI method.
It integrates KEEL engines into customers' larger control and command systems.

category_justification: KEEL is the product line of Compsim LLC, a for-profit Wisconsin limited liability company, and the RFI index lists the respondent as private sector.

name: KYield
description: KYield is a privately held U.S. technology company founded in 1997 by Mark Montgomery that develops enterprise artificial intelligence software. Its flagship product is the KYield Operating System (KOS), a proprietary neurosymbolic AI platform licensed to enterprises for data quality, governance, security, and employee digital assistants (DANA). The company markets the system through enterprise licensing and white-label arrangements rather than consumer products.
justification: KYield's primary activity is developing and licensing a proprietary enterprise AI operating system to business customers, which is software publishing.

alternates.justification: Enterprise deployments of KOS involve substantial customization and integration work for each client.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: If KOS is delivered primarily as a hosted, data-processing service, this code would apply.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: The firm is small and R&D-intensive, having spent decades developing and patenting its AI architecture.

category_justification: KYield, Inc. is a for-profit company selling enterprise software licenses, and the RFI respondent index labels it Private sector.

name: Knightscope
description: Knightscope is a publicly traded U.S. public-safety technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California. It designs, builds, and deploys Autonomous Security Robots (K-series) and emergency communication devices such as blue-light towers and call boxes, which it supplies to clients largely under a subscription Machine-as-a-Service model with monitoring support. Customers include corporate campuses, hospitals, malls, parking structures, and law-enforcement agencies.
justification: Knightscope's dominant revenue model is subscription delivery, deployment, and monitoring of security robots and emergency communication systems at client sites, which is a security systems service rather than a product sale.

alternates.justification: The company manufactures emergency communication devices and blue-light towers, and its SEC filings sit in the communications-equipment industry group.

alternates.naics_title: All Other Miscellaneous General Purpose Machinery Manufacturing
alternates.justification: Knightscope designs and assembles its autonomous ground robots in-house, an activity that falls to miscellaneous general purpose machinery manufacturing.
The robots perform patrol and surveillance functions that substitute for contracted guard patrol services.

category_justification: Knightscope is a for-profit corporation listed on Nasdaq (KSCP) and is labeled Private sector in the RFI respondent index.

name: Knowledge Ecology International (KEI)
description: Knowledge Ecology International is a Washington, DC-based nonprofit organization directed by James Love that works on the management of knowledge resources and the social effects of intellectual property policy. It conducts policy research and advocacy on drug pricing, patents, government-funded inventions, access to medicines, and access-to-knowledge issues before bodies such as WIPO, the WTO, and U.S. agencies. It has litigated and petitioned federal agencies, including suits and march-in petitions involving NIH-funded patents.
justification: KEI's primary activity is public-interest advocacy and campaigning on intellectual property and access-to-knowledge policy rather than service delivery or membership representation.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: KEI produces substantial original economic and legal policy research on patents, pricing, and innovation systems.
It functions as a civic organization promoting a public-interest agenda in international policy fora.
Its work is closely tied to legal and public-health professional communities, though it has no dues-paying professional membership.

category_justification: KEI is a 501(c)(3) public-interest NGO with a staff-driven research and advocacy mission and no dues-paying membership base, and the RFI index labels it Non-profit.

name: Knowledge Enterprise
resolved_name: Knowledge Enterprise (unverified; submission filed by Dr. Biren "Brian" Prasad, Editor-in-Chief, International Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Knowledge Engineering)
description: No organization operating publicly under the name Knowledge Enterprise could be confirmed as the submitter of this comment. The filing itself was made by Dr. Biren (Brian) Prasad, Editor-in-Chief of the International Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Knowledge Engineering (IJAIKE), published by the Association for the Advancement of Knowledge Solutions in cooperation with the EurAsia Academic Publishing Group. The comment text is largely a solicitation inviting collaboration with and editorial participation in that open-access AI journal rather than a policy submission from an identifiable institution.
justification: The only verifiable activity attached to the submission is publication of an open-access scholarly AI journal, but the named entity itself could not be confirmed.

alternates.justification: If the operation is a small online-only academic publishing venture, this residual publishing code may fit better.
The submitter's LinkedIn profile associates him with a knowledge-solutions consulting practice in Irvine, California.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: A name like Knowledge Enterprise could denote a knowledge-management research operation, though no such entity was found.

category_justification: Web research could not confirm any entity named Knowledge Enterprise; the RFI index label of Non-profit is unsupported by any locatable organizational record.

name: LILT
description: LILT is a for-profit U.S. company founded in 2015 that provides an enterprise AI translation and localization platform combining adaptive machine translation with human linguists. It sells software for translation management alongside managed localization services to corporate and government customers, including U.S. federal agencies. The company is headquartered in Emeryville, California and is venture-backed.
justification: LILT's primary output is translated and localized content delivered to enterprise clients through a combined AI-plus-human-linguist service model.

alternates.justification: LILT licenses a translation management and adaptive machine translation platform as a software product.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: The platform is delivered as a hosted cloud service processing customer content.
Enterprise deployments involve custom model adaptation and pipeline integration work.

category_justification: LILT is a venture-backed for-profit corporation selling commercial products and services, and the RFI index labels it Private sector.

name: LavaCrypt
description: LavaCrypt, LLC is a small U.S. limited liability company that describes itself as a research and development firm specializing in cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and quantum computing technologies. Its RFI submission, signed by Kadeem Jeffery, advocates AI cybersecurity standards, data provenance requirements, workforce readiness, and international collaboration. Very little independent public information about the company's products, size, or customers is available.
naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
justification: The firm self-describes its primary activity as research and development at the intersection of cybersecurity, AI, and quantum computing, which falls under physical and engineering sciences R&D.

alternates.justification: A small cybersecurity firm's revenue commonly comes from designing and securing client computer systems rather than pure R&D.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: The firm may operate mainly as a technical advisory practice on security and emerging technology.
If LavaCrypt commercializes encryption or security software products, software publishing would apply.

category_justification: The submission is signed on behalf of LavaCrypt, LLC, a for-profit limited liability company, and the RFI index labels it Private sector.

name: LearnerStudio
description: LearnerStudio is a U.S. nonprofit organization led by CEO Kim Smith that works on preparing young people to thrive in the age of AI. It identifies, incubates, and funds education ventures and learning models, convenes leaders across education, technology, philanthropy, and social entrepreneurship, and publishes research on future-ready skills. It is supported by philanthropic funders including the Gates Foundation, Walton Family Foundation, and Hewlett Foundation.
justification: LearnerStudio's primary activity is supporting and developing education programs, models, and ventures rather than directly instructing students.

alternates.justification: The organization mobilizes and deploys philanthropic funding into an education venture pipeline, resembling a venture-philanthropy grantmaker.
Much of its public work is agenda-setting advocacy for AI-era learning policy, including this federal RFI comment.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: It produces original research on skills, learning models, and youth outcomes in the age of AI.

category_justification: LearnerStudio operates at a .org domain as a philanthropically funded, mission-driven education organization with no membership base, and the RFI index labels it Non-profit.

name: Lexset
description: Lexset is a for-profit computer vision company founded in 2018 with offices in Brooklyn and Seattle. Its Seahaven product is a parametric 3D engine that generates photorealistic, fully annotated synthetic training data for machine learning teams, and its Sentinel product turns video and sensor feeds into geolocated, cited answers for operations teams. It sells to enterprise, infrastructure, and defense customers, including government programs and prime contractors.
justification: Lexset's primary activity is developing and licensing proprietary software products (Seahaven and Sentinel) for synthetic data generation and AI perception.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Generating synthetic datasets on demand for customers is a data processing and hosted-service activity.
Defense and infrastructure deployments typically require bespoke model and pipeline development per program.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: The company performs applied computer vision and sensor-perception research, some of it under government programs.

category_justification: Lexset is a venture-backed for-profit startup selling commercial software products, and the RFI index labels it Private sector.

name: LineVision
description: LineVision is a privately held Massachusetts-based grid technology company that supplies non-contact monitoring systems for high-voltage electric transmission lines. Its RS-1 sensor units, assembled in the United States, are mounted beneath conductors and paired with an analytics platform that delivers dynamic line ratings and situational-awareness data to utilities. The company sells the sensors and software together as a subscription service to transmission owners and grid operators.
naics_title: Instrument Manufacturing for Measuring and Testing Electricity and Electrical Signals
justification: LineVision's core product is a manufactured sensing instrument that measures conductor and electrical-system conditions on transmission lines, with analytics layered on top.

alternates.justification: Revenue is largely subscription access to its dynamic line rating analytics platform rather than one-time hardware sales.
The offering includes engineering analysis of transmission capacity for utility clients.

alternates.naics_title: Instruments and Related Products Manufacturing for Measuring, Displaying, and Controlling Industrial Process Variables
alternates.justification: The RS-1 also measures physical process variables such as weather, sag, and tower motion.

category_justification: A venture-backed for-profit vendor selling grid monitoring products to utilities; the RFI respondent index lists it as private sector.

name: Liquidax Capital
description: Liquidax Capital is a for-profit intellectual property advisory and asset management firm founded in 2014 with offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. It handles patent licensing and sales, IP valuation, IP-backed lending, and patent-focused investment for corporate, private equity, and investment fund clients. Its practice spans semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, energy, and artificial intelligence.
justification: The firm's primary activity is managing and advising on portfolios of intellectual property assets and related investments for fee-paying clients.

alternates.naics_title: Lessors of Nonfinancial Intangible Assets (except Copyrighted Works)
alternates.justification: A substantial part of the business is licensing patents and monetizing IP rights.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: It describes itself as an advisory firm providing technical IP strategy consulting.
IP-backed lending and deal structuring are specialized financial investment activities.

category_justification: A privately held LLC advisory firm; it is acting in part advisorily on behalf of unnamed corporate and investor clients, and the RFI index labels it private sector.

name: Lockheed Martin
description: Lockheed Martin is a publicly traded American aerospace and defense contractor headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland. It develops and manufactures combat aircraft, missiles and fire control systems, rotary and mission systems, and space vehicles, primarily for the US Department of Defense and allied governments. It is among the largest defense contractors in the world by revenue.
naics_title: Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing
justification: Lockheed Martin's registered industrial classification centers on guided missile and space vehicle production, which spans its Missiles and Fire Control and Space segments.

alternates.justification: Aeronautics, led by the F-35 program, is its single largest business segment by revenue.

alternates.naics_title: Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing
alternates.justification: It also produces subsystems and auxiliary equipment for missiles and space vehicles.

alternates.naics_title: Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing
alternates.justification: Its Rotary and Mission Systems segment builds radar, sensor, and guidance systems.

category_justification: A publicly traded for-profit corporation listed as private sector in the RFI respondent index.

name: Los Angeles County Business Federation
description: BizFed is a Los Angeles-based grassroots business advocacy alliance founded in 2008 that unites more than 240 member business organizations. Its members include chambers of commerce, trade associations, minority business groups, business improvement districts, and economic development organizations representing roughly 420,000 employers. It exists to advocate for policies and projects that strengthen the Southern California regional economy at local, state, and federal levels.
justification: Its sole activity is collective advocacy on behalf of dues-paying member business organizations, the defining function of a business association.
category_justification: It self-describes as an alliance of over 240 member business organizations, so the membership-base rule applies despite the RFI index labeling it non-federal government.

name: Lubrizol
resolved_name: The Lubrizol Corporation (a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway Inc.)
description: Lubrizol is an Ohio-headquartered specialty chemicals company that has been a wholly owned subsidiary of Berkshire Hathaway since 2011. Its largest business formulates additive packages for engine oils, driveline fluids, and industrial lubricants, and it also produces engineered polymers, coatings, and performance ingredients for personal care and health markets. It operates manufacturing and research facilities worldwide.
naics_title: All Other Miscellaneous Chemical Product and Preparation Manufacturing
justification: Its primary output is formulated chemical additive preparations for lubricants and fluids, which NAICS places in the miscellaneous chemical preparation class.

alternates.naics_title: All Other Basic Organic Chemical Manufacturing
alternates.justification: It manufactures organic chemical intermediates used in its additive and polymer lines.
Its Advanced Materials segment produces engineered thermoplastic polymers and resins.

alternates.naics_title: Petroleum Lubricating Oil and Grease Manufacturing
alternates.justification: Its products are sold into and blended with finished lubricating oils and greases.

category_justification: A for-profit specialty chemicals manufacturer owned by Berkshire Hathaway; the RFI index lists it as private sector.

name: Lumen Tech
description: Lumen Technologies is a publicly traded US telecommunications company headquartered in Denver, Colorado, formerly known as CenturyLink. It owns and operates one of the largest fiber-optic and internet backbone networks in the country, selling enterprise connectivity, edge computing, security, and wholesale transport services. It has been expanding its long-haul fiber network to serve AI and data center traffic demand while divesting its consumer fiber-to-the-home business.
justification: Lumen's primary activity is operating a wireline fiber-optic network and selling transport and connectivity services over it.
category_justification: A publicly traded for-profit carrier listed as private sector in the RFI respondent index.

name: Making AI Work for all Americans
resolved_name: Laboratory for Information and Decision Systems (LIDS), Massachusetts Institute of Technology
description: "Making AI Work for All Americans" is the title of the RFI submission filed on behalf of MIT's Laboratory for Information and Decision Systems (LIDS), an interdisciplinary research laboratory within the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. LIDS conducts research in systems, control, optimization, communications, statistics, and machine learning, and its faculty authored the response. The submission argues for federal investment in foundational AI research, shared data and compute infrastructure, and an independent AI oversight body.
justification: The submitting entity is a research laboratory that is an organizational sub-unit of MIT, a degree-granting private research university.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: LIDS' day-to-day activity is engineering and computational research rather than instruction.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: Part of the submission addresses AI policy, governance, and societal impact research.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: The response itself is technical policy advice offered to a federal agency.

category_justification: The PDF states it is submitted on behalf of MIT's Laboratory for Information and Decision Systems, a sub-unit of a degree-granting university, contrary to the index label of industry/professional association.

name: ManTech Advanced Systems International
resolved_name: ManTech Advanced Systems International, Inc. (principal operating subsidiary of ManTech International Corporation, owned by The Carlyle Group)
description: ManTech Advanced Systems International, Inc. is the main government contracting subsidiary of ManTech International Corporation, a Virginia-based technology services firm taken private by The Carlyle Group in 2022. It delivers systems engineering, software development, cybersecurity, cloud migration, data analytics, and IT operations to US defense, intelligence, and civilian federal agencies. justification: Its primary activity is designing, integrating, and supporting information technology systems under federal services contracts.

category_justification: A for-profit private-equity-owned federal contractor listed as private sector in the RFI respondent index.
